paite: Huan, Aron tapa nihte'n TOUPA a va naih ua a sihloh nung un TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a;
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Yahweh, and died;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Na unau Aron houpih inla, puanzak sung mun siangthou ah, bawm tung a chitna tutphah ma ah chiklai in leng hon lut hetkei heh, a si kha ding hi; chitna tutphah tungah, mei in ka hong kihil sin ahi.
english: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother, not to come at all times into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die: for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

paite: Hichi bang in Aron pen mun siangthou ah a hoh ding ahi: khelh thoihna ding in bawng tuai, haltum thillat ding in belampa toh.
english: “Herewith shall Aaron come into the sanctuary: with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

paite: Puan malngat puannak siangthou a silh ding a, a sa khuhna ding in puan malngat pheitawm a bun ding, puan malngat dial a khim ding ahi: hiaite puansilh siangthou ahi a; a kisil masa dia, a silh phet ding ahi.
english: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

paite: Huan, Israel suante mipi houna kelpa nih khelh thoihna ding in leh haltum thillat ding in belampa khat a tawi ding.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

paite: Huan, Aron in amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngpa pen a lan ding a, amah leh a innkote a ding in kilepna a bawl ding.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

paite: Kel nih a kai ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah a koih ding.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huan, Aron in kel nih tungthu ah ai a san ding a, khat TOUPA a tuam ahi ding a, khat Azazel a tuam ahi ding.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats; one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

paite: Huan, Aron in TOUPA a tuam dia puk kel a la ding a, khelh thoihna ding in a lan ding hi.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

paite: Azazel a tuam dia pukpuk kel bel kilepna bawlna ding a Azazel a ding a khah ding in TOUPA ma ah a hing in a koih ding hi.
english: But the goat, on which the lot fell for the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away for the scapegoat into the wilderness.

paite: Huan, Aron in ama a tuam khelhna bawngpa pen a la ding a, amah leh a innkote a ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngpa pen a gou ding ahi;
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

paite: Huan, TOUPA ma a maitam a kipan meilakna mei-am a khat a la ding a, gimlim mahmah gawizan ngingei pham khat toh puanzak sung lam ah a hon lupih ding a;
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:

paite: Gimlim khu in thu theihpihna tung a chitna tutphah a bopna ding in TOUPA ma a mei ah gimlim a buak ding a, sihna a tuah louhna ding in;
english: and he shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the testimony, so that he will not die.

paite: Huan, bawngpa sisan bangzah hiam a la ding a, a khut zung in chitna tutphah suah lam pang a theh ding a, a khut in chitna tutphah bul sisan in sagih vei a theh ding ahi.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

paite: Huan, mipi a tuam khelh thoihna kel pen a gou ding a, a sisan bawngpa sisan a bawl bang in a bawl ding a, chitna tutphah leh chitna tutphah bul a theh ding hi;
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

paite: Israel suante nitnate ziak leh a nitnate uh, a khelhna tengteng uh ziak in mun siangthou a ding in kilepna a bawl ding: huaimah bang in, a nitnate uh lak a om, kihoupihna puan inn a ding in leng a bawl sam ding ahi.
english: and he shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting, that dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness.

paite: Mun siangthou a kilepna bawl ding a a lut lai in, amah leh a innkote leh Israel mipte a ding in kilepna a bawl khit a a hong pawt khiak masiah kuamahmah peuh puan inn sung a a om ding uh ahi kei hi
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

paite: TOUPA ma a maitam lam ah a pawt ding a, huai a ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, bawngpa sisan leh kel sisan bangzah hiam a la ding a, maitam kite ah a kimvel in a tat ding hi.
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

paite: Huan, a khut in sagih vei a theh ding a, a siangsak ding a, Israel suante nitnate lak a kipan a hih siangthou ding.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

paite: Huan, mun siangthou leh kihoupihna puan inn leh maitam a ding a kilepna a bawl khit in kel hing pen a lan ding:
english: “When he has made an end of atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

paite: Aron in kel hing lu tungah a khut langnih a koih ding a, a tungah Israel suante ginatlouhna tengteng, a tatlekna tengteng, a khelhna tengteng uh tan in a samkhe ding a; huaite kel lu tungah a nga ding a, mi khat a sehkholhsa un gamdai lam ah a pi mang ding:
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.

paite: Huan, kel in a thulimlouhna tengteng uh luahlouh gamah a po ding a, kel bel gamdai ah a khah ding hi.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall let the goat go in the wilderness.

paite: Huan, Aron kihoupihna puan inn ah a lut ding a, mun siangthou a lut lai a puan malngat puansilh a silh a suah ding a, huailai ah a nuse ding hi;
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

paite: Huan, mun siangthou ah a kisil ding a, a puansilh a silh ding, a hong pawtkhe ding a, amah a tuam haltum thillat leh mipi a tuam haltum thillat a lan ding a, amah leh mipi a ding kilepna a bawl ding.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

paite: Huan, khelh thoihna thau maitam ah a hal ding.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

paite: Huan, Azazel a tuam kel khahmi kuapeuh in a puante uh a sawp ding ua, a kisil ding ua, huai khit chiang in a omna mun lam uah a pai nawn ding uh ahi.
english: “He who lets the goat go for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngpa leh khelh thoihna kel sisan kilepna a bawlna ding a mun siangthou a a lutpih uh dai po lam ah a paipih ding ahi; a vun, a sa, a ek a hal ding uh ahi.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried forth outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

paite: A hal mi in a puan a sawp ding a, a kisil ding a, huai khit in om mun lam ah a pai nawn ding ahi.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: Huan, hiai na khantawn dan ding uh ahi: kha sagihna, huai kha ni sawm ni in na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding ua, na gam ua mi him hiam, gamdang mi na lak ua teng hiam in nnasep bangmah a sep ding uh ahi kei hi:
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, the native-born, or the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you:

paite: Hiai ni in noute hih siangthouna ding in noute ding in kilepna bawl ahi sin hi; huchi in TOUPA ma ah na khelhna tengteng lak ua kipan na siangthou ding uhi.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins you shall be clean before Yahweh.

paite: Nou ding in khawl kinkenna ni ahi a, na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding uh; khantawn dan ding ahi.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls; it is a statute forever.

paite: Huan, siampu, a pa sik a siampu hi ding a sathau nilh ding leh hihtuam mi ding in kilepna a bawl ding a, puan malngat puansilh siangthou a silh ding a; mun siangthou a ding in kilepna a bawl ding; kihoupihna puan inn leh maitam a ding in kilepna a bawl sam ding hi;
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

paite: Huan, siampute leh mipi hon a ding in kilepna bawl nawn lai ding.A khelh tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khat vei Israel suante a dia kilepna bawl na khantawn dan ding uh ahi, a chi a. Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in a hih hi.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

paite: A khelh tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khat vei Israel suante a dia kilepna bawl na khantawn dan ding uh ahi, a chi a. Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu a piak bang in a hih hi.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.
